sql:
SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id 
FROM atom a1, atom a2, connected c, bond b, molecule m 
WHERE a1.atom_id = c.atom_id AND a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 
AND c.bond_id = b.bond_id AND b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
AND b.bond_type = '#' AND m.molecule_id = 'TR041'
